name: openbb_equity_metrics
description:
Key valuation and profitability metrics for one stock (P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA, ROE, margins, growth, dividend yield) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.metrics).
Returns: {symbol, provider, period, metrics: [one current record for yfinance, one per period for fmp]} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; period (annual or quarter; fmp only); limit (periods; fmp only); provider (fmp, intrinio, yfinance; default yfinance).
Ratios table: openbb_equity_fundamental_ratios; another source: av_company_overview. Keys: yfinance needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; intrinio needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
